purpose: Create the missing original campaign model and neutral exact-product try-on proof before any Love Hurts final-scene spend.

model_cast.identity: one original adult Black woman, consistent across both views
model_cast.age_presentation: adult, approximately late twenties to early thirties
model_cast.presence: confident, self-possessed, powerful and professional Oakland luxury-streetwear customer
model_cast.build: athletic natural build with realistic anatomy
model_cast.hair: natural textured hair styled clear of the waistband and pocket regions
model_cast.styling: minimal fitted sleeveless black crop top ending above the waistband, simple black low-profile sneakers, no jacket, bag, jewelry, or accessory obscuring the shorts
model_cast.reuse_boundary: candidate identity may not enter LH-COMMERCE-2 until founder-approved and hash-bound

views: full-body rear-three-quarter with a natural over-shoulder turn
composition.identity_rule: both views must depict the same person with stable face, skin tone, hair, body proportions, and age
composition.lighting: even soft directional studio light with realistic contact shadows and no dramatic color cast
forbidden: split identity or two different people

higgsfield.tool: product-photoshoot enhance-only followed by pinned gpt_image_2 generation
higgsfield.user_intent: Create one original adult Black woman SkyyRose campaign model as a neutral two-view casting board wearing the exact supplied LH-003 shorts: the same person shown full-body front-three-quarter and rear-three-quarter, powerful professional luxury-streetwear presence, realistic anatomy and garment fit, fitted black crop top ending above the waistband, simple black low-profile sneakers, clean gray cyclorama, even studio light, no props, no scene, no added display text, and no layer obscuring the waistband or pockets.
higgsfield.brand_context: SkyyRose Love Hurts is controlled romantic urban cinema and Oakland luxury streetwear. This is a neutral casting proof, so customer dignity, exact product clarity, and professional campaign presence outrank spectacle.
higgsfield.product_context: Use all four physical views as construction authority. Preserve white perforated mesh, all-over orange-red rose bouquets on clouds, black ribbed waistband, angular black mesh side panels, red-white-black leg binding, and the exact words Love Hurts where visible. Construction has exactly two vertical zippered side hand pockets and two horizontal zippered rear pockets; every visible pocket must show its black zipper closure, and occluded pockets must not be moved, duplicated, removed, or replaced. Direction is from the wearer's body, never from the camera: WEARER-LEFT front/side has the large red Love Hurts script and the black mesh inset with the smaller Love Hurts rose/heart emblem; WEARER-RIGHT black mesh inset has the embroidered red rose bouquet with green stems over a white-and-blue cloud. The back is predominantly white rose-print mesh with two horizontal rear zipper pockets and the large WEARER-LEFT red-and-black Love Hurts treatment; there is no center-back black pentagonal panel. Do not invent cargo, patch, open-welt, or extra pockets. Do not mirror the artwork, swap wearer-left and wearer-right panels, move side-panel artwork onto the center back, or add any new logo or wording.

pinned_enhanced_prompt.generation_rule: Submit this exact reviewed backend prompt to gpt_image_2 with the four ordered source bindings; do not re-enhance or freehand it.

observe: verify the four input hashes before enhancement and generation
record the exact enhanced prompt returned by the backend without hand rewriting it
orient: model creation is the primary objective
product fidelity is the hard commercial constraint
final scene and sculpture references are intentionally excluded

two vertical side pockets and two horizontal rear pockets with zipper closures
exact Love Hurts garment text where visible with no added display text
fitted black crop top and black low-profile sneakers

hard_fail_invariants: pocket count, zipper, directional artwork, side-panel, waistband, or trim drift
different person across views or broken anatomy
scene, monument, display text, or unrequested prop contamination
